Hey Samir — I'm Ben (on onboarding / integration). Two quick notes from the engineering side:

1) We've seen Gmail mobile add soft line breaks when a long query string lacks punctuation (it sometimes inserts "
" in the visible rendering). If the token parameter is at the line break boundary the client may not include it when navigating.
2) Our redirector supports a short-lived short link (rdr.redwood.ai/s/XXXXX) which avoids the client preview problem. I can generate a short link and send it over DM or in the body as a visible code block.

Action plan: I captured the raw invitation that went out and attached it (invite-raw-eml.txt) and a sample screenshot from our test devices. I will:
- Generate a one-time short redirect and paste it as plain text in a follow-up email
- Add a note to the invite template to include the full URL in a code block for mobile users

Samir, can you confirm whether your team prefers a short redirect or a plain-text code-block? If you’re good with short redirect I’ll send the one-time link now.

Attachments: invite-raw-eml.txt (raw headers + body), screenshot-1.png (internal test)

Thanks,
